_help: Wild Hunter update check. 'latest' = newest build in the store (players below it see an 'Update ready' popup with Later). 'min' = oldest build still allowed (players below it must update). 0 = off. iOS build = the iOS build number, Android build = the Google Play version code.

ios.whatsNew: A whole new look: log bottom bar, rope XP bar, framed pages, the Lodge and Pack, painted skill effects, a new Workshop window and themed research trees.

android.whatsNew: Fixes: expeditions no longer get stuck, cleaner lettering, one-page Relics with digging, roomier Workshop.

_mailHelp: Wild Hunter Mailbox. Each letter: id (letters, numbers, - or _; never reuse one), from, title, body (\n = new line), gifts {gems, gold, goldBags (1 bag = a quest's gold at the player's stage), pelts, egg, eggRare, eggEpic, eggLegendary, runes, scrolls, shards, picks}, start and end (YYYY-MM-DD = the player's local midnight; end = the moment it disappears), platform (all, ios or android), startedBefore / startedAfter (only players who started before/after that day), minStage (e.g. 3-1). Gifts can be claimed once per player. Players see changes the next time the game opens or comes back to the screen.

mail.title: Wild Hunter is here!
mail.body:
Thank you for hunting with us on launch week!
Here's a launch gift to help you on your way. Join our Discord to share your hunts, report bugs and hear about new updates first.
